verdict.rationale: Bench is a bookkeeping SaaS-plus-service, so a documented public API is a fair question to ask of it. The pack shows no API, no developer docs and no OpenAPI spec; probes for openapi.json, swagger.json, llms.txt and markdown docs all returned 404. Inbound data integrations (Plaid, Shopify, Stripe, Gusto) and in-app chat do not count as a public API the user can drive.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can drive the product through a documented public API
